sonnet.problem: This story card is only a joke about a double shift and a burnt cookie. It tells nothing from the passage, so it doesn't move the baker forward. The verse 7 content was already covered on cards 11 and 12.
sonnet.rule: Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.

sonnet.problem: Verse 11 says the speaker will be able to answer the one who taunts him ("so that I can answer him who taunts me"). The question says the son's wisdom lets "him" answer, and the right answer says the one who taunts "him". It is unclear who "him" is, and it suggests the son does the answering, which the verse doesn't say.
sonnet.rule: Clear English. Every card reads correctly. ... "He," "she" and "they" always point to someone the baker can tell.
